posts.title: PRESS RELEASE: Folkroom Launches Open Archive of 13,440+ Living Traditions (CC BY-SA)
posts.description: Folkroom (https://folkroom.org) is a free, open-access public archive of 13,440+ living folk and traditional art forms across 160+ places, 42 country editions, 7 tradition families, and 10 native language portals. Every factual claim is tied to a tiered primary citation, transmission vitality is tracked across an IUCN-modeled 4-tier Red List, and all text is published under CC BY-SA 4.0 with zero

posts.title: Bhavai dance [भवाई नृत्य] (Udaipur & Jodhpur, Rajasthan, India) — Dance
posts.description: Rajasthani equilibrium dance in which women balance seven to eleven brass or earthen pitchers on their heads while pirouetting on the rim of a brass plate. [Vitality: Stable · First attested: 14th century · National Inventory]

posts.title: Gotipua [ଗୋଟିପୁଅ] (Raghurajpur, Odisha, India) — Dance
posts.description: Acrobatic temple dance of Odisha performed by young boys dressed as Radha and Krishna, and the direct historical precursor of classical Odissi. [Vitality: Stable · First attested: 16th century · National Inventory]
